scope: Post hoc fixed 200 images; matched neutral label-only prompt, not the original multi-field benchmark prompt. Category-only uses eight unique queries per label order, expanded over 25 images each. Paired category-stratified image bootstrap conditions on these eight categories, the panel, deterministic outputs and the fixed shuffle; it does not estimate prompt or category population uncertainty. Invalid labels are retained as failures, never recoded as unclear. Label-order analyses are sensitivity checks, not independent replications.
